description.en: DramaBox is an English expressive TTS and voice-cloning model packaged for audio.cpp as a standalone GGUF bundle. It combines Gemma text conditioning, diffusion sampling, reference-audio conditioning, long-form chunking, and 48 kHz stereo output.
description.zh: DramaBox 是面向 audio.cpp 以独立 GGUF 包提供的英语表现力 TTS 与音色克隆模型。融合 Gemma 文本条件、扩散采样、参考音频条件、长文本分块与 48 kHz 立体声输出。

target_voice.en: Reference voice WAV path for voice cloning. If omitted, DramaBox generates from text without reference-audio conditioning.
target_voice.zh: 音色克隆用的参考 WAV 路径。省略时不带参考音频条件，直接由文本生成。

negative_prompt.en: Negative text conditioning used when guidance_scale enables classifier-free guidance; omitted uses the built-in quality prompt.
negative_prompt.zh: 当 guidance_scale 启用无分类器引导时使用的负向文本条件；省略时使用内置质量提示。

duration_sec.en: Explicit target duration in seconds; default 0 uses the prompt-duration estimator. Above audio_chunk_threshold_sec, long-form generation uses estimated per-chunk durations instead of this explicit target.
duration_sec.zh: 显式目标时长（秒）；默认 0 使用提示时长估算器。超过 audio_chunk_threshold_sec 时，长文本生成使用每分块估算时长而不是该显式目标。

num_inference_steps.en: Diffusion sampling step count; default comes from config.json, 30 in the current package.
num_inference_steps.zh: 扩散采样步数；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 30。

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 2.5 in the current package. Values greater than 1 enable CFG. Negative values disable this guidance branch.
guidance_scale.zh: 无分类器引导强度；默认来自 config.json，当前包为 2.5。大于 1 启用 CFG；负值关闭该引导分支。

spatio_temporal_guidance_scale.en: Spatio-temporal guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 1.5 in the current package. Values greater than 0 enable STG. Negative values disable this guidance branch.
spatio_temporal_guidance_scale.zh: 时空引导强度；默认来自 config.json，当前包为 1.5。大于 0 启用 STG；负值关闭该引导分支。

duration_scale.en: Multiplier applied to the estimated prompt duration when duration_sec is 0; default comes from config.json, 1.1 in the current package. The resulting duration has a 3-second floor.
duration_scale.zh: duration_sec=0 时应用到估算提示时长的倍率；默认来自 config.json，当前包为 1.1。结果时长下限为 3 秒。

reference_duration_sec.en: Reference voice crop/repeat duration in seconds; default comes from config.json, 10.0 in the current package. Must be > 0.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 参考音色裁剪/重复时长（秒）；默认来自 config.json，当前包为 10.0。必须 >0。

guidance_rescale.en: Guidance rescale: auto or any negative value derives it from guidance_scale; nonnegative numeric values select an explicit rescale.
guidance_rescale.zh: 引导重缩放：auto 或任意负值根据 guidance_scale 推导；非负数值选择显式重缩放。

audio_chunk_threshold_sec.en: Estimated duration threshold that switches a request to long-form chunking; default 45.0 seconds. Must be > 0.
audio_chunk_threshold_sec.zh: 切换到长文本分块的估算时长阈值；默认 45.0 秒。必须 >0。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Target estimated duration for each long-form chunk; default 37.0 seconds. Must be > 0.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 每个长文本分块的目标估算时长；默认 37.0 秒。必须 >0。

cross_fade_duration_sec.en: Equal-power cross-fade between long-form chunks in seconds; default 0.05. Zero still overlaps one sample.
cross_fade_duration_sec.zh: 长文本分块间的等功率交叉淡入淡出（秒）；默认 0.05。0 仍会重叠一个采样。

seed.en: Torch-compatible CUDA noise seed for diffusion sampling; default 42.
seed.zh: 扩散采样用的 Torch 兼容 CUDA 噪声种子；默认 42。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

licenses.name: LTX-2 Community License
licenses.notes: A paid license is needed from USD 10M yearly revenue. Generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated. Not for products that compete with Lightricks'. The Gemma 3 text encoder falls under the Gemma Terms of Use.
